day_05_morning: ^Wren's house is smaller than it looks from the street. Every wall is covered in paper.
^Maps of Aurel. Lists of names. Nine circles drawn over the same three streets.
^Toma is at the table when you come in, ink to the elbows, copying a page he has already copied four times.
^You are the Bellkeeper, he says. I have been writing you down for six years.
^Wren closes the door behind you. Mara and Iven fill the room until it feels like a held breath.
^The first crack was not an accident, Wren says. Someone rang the Bell on the wrong day.
^Toma sets down his pen. The Quiet is not a thing that came to Aurel, he says. It is what the city has been carrying.
^Keep the discovery between the four of you.
who: ^The first Bellkeeper, Wren says. My mother. She rang it to save someone she loved.
^The Bell listened. It has been listening ever since.
^Toma writes this down. His hand is shaking.
remember: ^Everything, Toma says. That is the problem. Every loop, all at once.
^He turns the page. It is your handwriting. You do not remember writing it.
^The first crack was a door, he says. Someone opened it and could not close it.
quiet: ^You close the curtains. The four of you sit in the small dark and breathe.
^No one says it, but you all understand: the Quiet already knows.
day_05_afternoon: ^The knock comes at noon. It is not a knock. It is a bell, struck once, exactly the way you strike it.
^The door opens. The Hollow Bellkeeper steps in wearing your face.
^It holds an iron rod. It moves like a memory of you.
^Toma grabs the papers. Wren does not move.
^It is not here for them, Mara says. It is here for you.
inside: ^You plant your feet. The Hollow Bellkeeper mirrors you, perfectly, a half-beat late.
^Toma pulls the papers into his arms. Wren stands between him and the door.
^Break the mirror, Iven says. I will keep the walls standing.
garden: ^You go through the back door. The Hollow Bellkeeper follows, exactly as you knew it would.
^The garden is full of names. The thing wearing your face does not look at them.
^Wren locks the house behind you. Smart girl.
day_05_night: ^The Hollow Bellkeeper falls. Its face comes apart into a hundred sheets of paper.
^Each sheet has the same name on it. Yours.
^Toma is crying. Wren is not. Mara is holding her hammer like she forgot she put it down.
^The first Bellkeeper is still alive, Wren says. She is the Quiet. She has been ringing the Bell from the other side.
^The crack widens. The room goes very still.
^Ask Wren what she wants to do.
share: ^You tell them. All of it, from the first bell to the ninth.
^Mara listens without interrupting. Iven writes nothing down.
^Then we end it, Mara says. Together.
alone: ^You keep the last piece to yourself. It sits behind your teeth like a second tongue.
^Iven watches you. He does not ask. That is worse.
choice: ^Wren looks at the papers, then at you. I want to meet her, she says. Before we decide.
^Toma closes his eyes. Mara closes her hand around the hammer.
